title: Fraction to Recurring Decimal
summary: Given two integers for a fraction, express the fraction as a string.
statement: Given two integers for a fraction, express the fraction as a string. If the decimal part repeats, enclose the repeating digits in parentheses. Multiple valid answers are acceptable. The length of the string representation will not exceed 10,000 characters. If the decimal is finite, return it without parentheses.
constraints: Inputs are signed 32-bit integers and denominator is nonzero.
Enclose only the repeating decimal suffix in parentheses.
hints: Long division is determined entirely by the current remainder.
Map each remainder to the digit position where it first appeared.
On remainder zero the decimal terminates; on a repeated remainder wrap the corresponding suffix in parentheses.
A repeated state must generate the same future digits, and no earlier digits belong to that cycle.
editorial: A repeated state must generate the same future digits, and no earlier digits belong to that cycle.
